sources: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf (Orange County Fee Directory 2026-2027, effective 10/1/26, p. 14 Camping and Related Fees)
https://florangectyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?module=RN (Moss Park filter, 46 campsites listed; item details for MOS Campsite 08, 10, 28)

values.note: Orange County fee directory effective 10/1/26: site rental $18 a night (6 people, 2 vehicles, power and water, dump use), $23 for non-county residents; +$2 per extra person, +$3 per extra vehicle a night. Cancelling less than three days ahead costs one night. Moss Park's own admission fee is $5 a vehicle from August 11, 2026.

fees.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf ('Site Rental, per night, (6 people, 1 dump, 2 vehicles, power and water) $18.00'; 'Site Rental (non County resident) 23.00') + https://www.orangecountyfl.net/cultureparks/parks.aspx?m=dtlvw&d=29 ('Effective August 11, 2026, the Park Admission Fee is $5 per vehicle'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://florangectyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/iteminfo.html?Module=RN&FMID=153346 (MOS Campsite 08: 'Potable Water', 'Power 50 Amp'; same on Campsites 10 and 28) + fee directory ('power and water'), read 2026-10-21 in a browser

facilities.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf (site rental includes '1 dump'; 'Non-registered sanitary dump fee 5.00'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Individual sites are booked online only (Orange County WebTrac, needs a free account; 'reservations are not accepted over the phone or by email'), no more than 45 days ahead; family, group and accessible sites by calling the park at 407-254-6840. Check in and set up before the park closes (8 p.m. summer, 6 p.m. winter) for the gate code. All county campgrounds close from noon Dec 23 to 2 p.m. Dec 26.

booking.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/CultureParks/CampingEnvironmentalEducation.aspx ('accept online reservations for individual campsites no more than 45-days prior to your stay'; 'reservations are not accepted over the phone or by email') + https://florangectyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?module=RN (notices: check-in before park close, holiday closure), read 2026-10-21

note: Orange County park between Lake Mary Jane and Lake Hart. No pets (ADA service animals excepted) and no alcohol. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Orange County's pages and WebTrac: $18 a night ($23 non-county), 50-amp power and water at the sites, online-only booking for individual sites up to 45 days ahead. Added the non-resident surcharge, dump station, the booking window and rules. Not stated: sewer, showers, season. Sites group left as it was (derived 54 sites / 45 ft max): WebTrac lists 46 online sites with 70 x 12 ft pads ('Back In or Pull In' on the three sampled), but no page states a site total or a vehicle limit. Note: dropped the site/hookup/booking/rating text.
